Want to use the app? Use the UI 👉, or ask me to!

enhancement.description: Nokia 3310-style Snake game — grow the snake, chase the high score, one wall away from game over.
enhancement.prompt: Build me a Snake game like the old Nokia 3310 one where I steer the snake around to eat food, it grows longer each time, and the game ends if I hit the walls or myself, with a score counter.
enhancement.response:
Done — **Archestra Snake 3310** is a playable Nokia-style snake game.

- Snake moves continuously on a grid, and you steer with the arrow keys
- Eating food grows the snake by one segment and bumps your score
- Running into a wall or into your own tail ends the game
- Live score display up top, plus a game-over screen with a restart option
- That retro 3310 monochrome look, green pixels on a dark screen

Click into the game panel to give it keyboard focus, then use the arrow keys to start moving. Have fun!
